verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs state it provides official SDK clients in Python and TypeScript, and Document AI is delivered through the Mistral platform API, so developers can build against first-party SDKs. The evidence is a single mention, and none of it shows the SDKs being used for OCR or annotation calls. Missing for 10: explicit SDK coverage or code examples for the Document AI/OCR endpoints, SDK reference depth (versioning, typed models), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We provide official SDK clients in both Python and Typescript
